compiled_state.description:
Discovered from ADEVX-102.

PostgresSideEffectLedger.reserve only returns replayed=True for a _COMPLETED row, and its insert uses on_conflict_do_nothing. An effect passed to run_once that raises therefore never reaches record(), so its side-effect key stays _PENDING and the effect re-runs on the next reconcile pass.

For intake that effect is _launch in services/orchestration/intake_reconciler.py, which calls execution_seeder.seed() and captures a task snapshot before calling starter.start(). Any raise from start() leaves an orphaned execution row and snapshot behind, and produces another pair on every later pass.

ADEVX-102 closed this for the declared-base case by resolving the branch through IntakeContext.base_resolver before the ledger effect runs. The gap remains for any caller of reconcile_intake that supplies no base_resolver, and for the pre-existing CalledProcessError path from remote_head.

Options are to make a hold terminal by recording the ledger key, to seed only after the workflow starts, or to require a resolver whenever a base is declared.
compiled_state.title: Intake re-seeds an execution every pass when a started workflow raises
